US Private Sector Added 90,000 Jobs in September

The U.S. private sector added 90,000 jobs in September, according to ADP, a figure that exceeded expectations. The report indicated job growth in manufacturing and construction sectors, with trade associations noting a significant number of unfilled positions in these areas. Analysts are watching to see if continued consumer spending can sustain this job growth.
